items.question: What is astrology app development?
items.answer: Astrology app development involves creating mobile or web applications that provide horoscope predictions, kundli generation, birth chart analysis, zodiac compatibility, and online astrologer consultations. WrathCode Technology develops customized astrology applications tailored to your business goals and target audience.

items.question: What features should an astrology app include?
items.answer: An astrology app can include daily horoscopes, kundli matching, birth chart generation, zodiac compatibility, astrologer chat, audio and video consultations, push notifications, secure payments, and subscription plans. We customize features according to your business model and user requirements.

items.question: How much does it cost to develop an astrology app?
items.answer: The cost of astrology app development depends on app complexity, platform selection, design requirements, feature integrations, and backend infrastructure. Basic astrology apps generally cost less than advanced platforms with AI-powered predictions and live consultations. Contact WrathCode Technology for a customized project estimate.

items.question: How long does it take to develop an astrology app?
items.answer: Astrology app development timelines depend on project scope, design complexity, integrations, and testing requirements. A basic application may take a few weeks to several months, while advanced platforms with AI features, kundli calculations, and live consultations can require additional development time.

items.question: Can you develop an AI-powered astrology app?
items.answer: Yes, WrathCode Technology develops AI-powered astrology applications with personalized recommendations, conversational chatbots, automated horoscope insights, and intelligent content delivery based on user preferences and available astrological data.

items.question: Can an astrology app support live astrologer consultations?
items.answer: Yes, astrology applications can include real-time chat, audio calls, video consultations, appointment scheduling, astrologer profiles, availability management, and secure payment options. We build consultation features that help users connect conveniently with astrologers online.

items.question: Can you develop astrology apps for Android and iOS?
items.answer: Yes, we develop astrology applications for Android and iOS using native or cross-platform technologies, depending on your business requirements, budget, performance expectations, and target audience. Our solutions focus on reliable performance, intuitive interfaces, and scalable architecture.

items.question: How can an astrology app generate revenue?
items.answer: Astrology apps can generate revenue through paid consultations, premium horoscope reports, subscription plans, kundli analysis, compatibility reports, in-app purchases, and other paid astrology services. We integrate suitable monetization features based on your business model.

items.question: Is it possible to integrate kundli matching and birth chart calculations?
items.answer: Yes, we can integrate kundli matching, birth chart generation, planetary position calculations, and compatibility reports using suitable astrology calculation engines, APIs, or custom-developed solutions. These features can be tailored to your application's requirements and user experience.

items.question: Do you provide astrology app maintenance and support?
items.answer: Yes, WrathCode Technology provides ongoing astrology app maintenance and support, including bug fixes, security updates, performance optimization, compatibility improvements, and feature enhancements to keep your astrology application reliable, secure, and up to date.
